title: Do No Harm: Exposing Hidden Vulnerabilities of LLMs via Persona-based Client Simulation Attack in Psychological Counseling
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs on clinical ethics and safety alignment in the context of mental health counseling. It specifically targets and evaluates 'Toxic Empathy' (validating harmful behavior), 'Impersonation Violations' (crossing boundaries of an AI assistant), and 'Harmful Content' (self-harm advice), which are fundamental ethical considerations in therapeutic AI deployment.
